scope: Continuity handlers only; tool approval and package handlers are sibling work.

criteria.behavior: Signed plain and wrapped ContextVM failover/recovery requests reach the real executor behind the fleet operator gate.
Unauthorized authors and empty/nil allowlists cause no continuity storage reads or writes.
Author/kind-scoped definitions hydrate from history and remain live; completion requires real EOSE, never elapsed time, CLOSED or exhaustion.
Definition replay is mutation-free and equal-timestamp ordering converges; command replay reuses retained outcomes, including after transport restart.
Missing method registration yields -32601; invalid signatures and unsupported standby definitions are rejected before storage.

deliberately_unwired.reason: No inventory consumer exists; do not introduce a competing placement/authority source just to eliminate unused lint.
